name: connecting-dots
description: Root scripts for the Connecting Dots monorepo (each app keeps its own package.json and lockfile).

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix apps/extension && npm ci --prefix apps/dashboard
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/extension && npm run build --prefix apps/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/extension && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/dashboard
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/dashboard && node scripts/check-no-localhost.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
